args.text: A popcorn shop! Top: three customers at a red counter, each with a popcorn bubble over their head - they want popcorn. Middle: a kitchen with a hopper and a crane arm, looks idle. Bottom (highlighted red): a red popcorn machine inside a circular gauge - red/yellow/blue ring with a needle/dial at the right, maybe a timing meter. Row of empty circles under it, maybe kernels or popcorn count. Locked slots on the right. Bottom panel: a pot/tin icon, 30 coins, +4 > +6 and an up arrow - an upgrade that costs 30. I have 0 coins. I think I can press the popcorn machine (to pop?), the up arrow (upgrade), top buttons (back, sparkle, sound, restart). I expect tapping the machine makes popcorn and the ring is a heat gauge where I should release in the yellow zone.

Tapping the machine started something: a white dot ran around the ring, a popcorn puff rose to the kitchen crane and then up to the counter, a customer got served and I now have 8 coins. The upgrade panel at the bottom fills with a yellow bar toward 30. Not sure if timing mattered. Going to tap again and watch the ring closely.

Each tap = +8 coins, one popcorn served. The ring looks like blue (cold) clockwise into yellow (good) then red (burnt?). My guess: holding the machine moves the dot around and letting go in the yellow part gives a better batch. Trying a 2 second hold.

Got it! Holding is cooking: the marker moves clockwise while I hold, and releasing at 1.6s landed in the yellow zone - burst of popcorn and confetti, and the little circles below filled gold (3 of 9 now). Feels good. Coins 25, upgrade almost affordable. Doing another 1.6s hold.

Bought the upgrade for 30: machine got a striped awning, popcorn rained down - nice. Next upgrade 54 for +6 to +8. The sign at the counter changed from a crossed-out cup to a striped popcorn bucket, and the middle kitchen panel got a glow with a bucket icon on the right edge. Wondering if the kitchen is something I can use now. Cooking more first.

Filled all 9 gold circles - huge popcorn explosion, circles reset, and one dot lit up on the little board next to the counter sign (it shows a striped bucket now). The kitchen conveyor now has striped buckets and the crane is filling them - like a combo reward turned popcorn into a bucket order. Counter is empty of customers right now. Going to tap the kitchen to see if it does anything.

Tapping the kitchen selected it: a side card shows stats (time 4.0 to 3.0, bucket value 15 to 20) and the bottom bar now offers a kitchen upgrade for 250. The kitchen fills buckets on its own - my coins went 45 to 55 without cooking. So tapping a panel picks which station the bottom upgrade applies to. I have 55, enough for the machine upgrade (54) - switching back to the machine via its icon.

Machine icon selected the machine: side card showed +6 to +8, 500 to 550 (star - maybe max heat?), and a cart-on-wheels next model. Bought the 54 upgrade. Kitchen has a stack of 5 buckets waiting with no customers - maybe customers come back later. One last perfect cook.
